acceptance_scope: Transient native document-position cue on the optimized existing candidate: measured UI scale, page zoom, dynamic geometry, nested scrollers, short documents, native input pass-through and rendered fade on light/dark pages
rebuild_reason: Only portable tests and validation documentation added; candidate production sources are unchanged
behavior_verified: Trailing-edge cue geometry follows actual root document position
Nested-only scrolling and dynamic expansion without document movement do not create the cue
Short documents and navigation clear the cue
2x X11 and Wayland UI scales are measured from native surface and page metrics; 1.5x X11 also verified
Page zoom from native Ctrl+plus is measured at 1.21x in dark-page Wayland and X11 cases
Trusted click/wheel/touch events at a measured point inside the painted cue reach the underlying page
Default native wheel and touch drag scroll the document beneath the cue; taps retain compatibility clicks
Light/dark captures have intermediate fade opacity followed by zero visible cue at 0.9s and 1.15s after the initial capture
All five private browser cases close with exit code zero
harness_corrections_preserved: First prototype compared stale pre-resize metrics with a new surface size; removed unnecessary resize at verified 1x

Second prototype included the native mouse cursor in the edge crop and requested repeated identical scroll positions; park the cursor outside the crop and request distinct positions before each motion phase
Earlier scale prototype uses documented private desktop_resize to establish measured 2x Wayland geometry; no scale assertion weakened
limits: Software-rendered private displays and local flat light/dark fixtures; no all-page contrast or hardware rendering claim
Native touch fixture traverses real Wayland/FLTK/Servo routes; physical touchscreen validation is not claimed
These 97 checks are separate from the 1947 WebXR/stability checks on the same candidate
System installation remains queued behind the existing native sudo prompt; no duplicate prompt started
Overall browser objective remains active; no full WebXR conformance or every-site stability claim
